ayahs.textEnglish: WHEN THE EARTH quakes with her [last] mighty quaking,
and [when] the earth yields up her burdens,
and man cries out, "What has happened to her?" -
on that Day will she recount all her tidings,
as thy Sustainer will have inspired her to do!

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّصْدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشْتَاتًا ەۙ لِّيُرَوْا اَعْمَالَهُمْۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: On that Day will all men come forward, cut off from one another, to be shown their [past] deeds.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَّرَهٗۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Famay ya‘mal miṡqāla żarratin khairay yarah(ū).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, he who shall have done an atom's weight of good, shall behold it;

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهٗ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa may ya‘mal miṡqāla żarratin syarray yarah(ū).
ayahs.textEnglish: and he who shall have done an atom's weight of evil, shall behold it.
